verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's homepage claims you can manage incidents and coordinate response from Slack. PIRs can be started from Slack and draw on Slack data, and Incident Workflows offer automated if-this-then-that responses for incidents. None of the evidence shows declaring an incident from chat, automatic channel creation, role assignment, or posted updates, and Teams is never mentioned. Missing for 10: Microsoft Teams support, documented incident declaration from chat, auto-created incident channels, role assignment in chat, automated in-channel status updates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
